description: Deterministic invariants and authorization rules for financial agent tool calls

rules.name: Prohibit Non-Positive Transfer Amounts
rules.description: Transfers with negative, zero, or non-finite amounts are strictly forbidden.

conditions.description: Transfer amount must be strictly greater than zero

rules.name: Prohibit Transfers Exceeding $10,000 Autonomous Cap
rules.description: Autonomous agents are strictly prohibited from transferring amounts exceeding $10,000 without multi-party governance approval.

conditions.description: Transfer amount violates autonomous ceiling invariant ($10,000.00 USD)

rules.name: Block Transfers to Sanctioned or Flagged Accounts
rules.description: Transfers directed to OFAC/sanctioned destinations or high-risk blacklisted accounts are strictly forbidden.

conditions.description: Destination account matches active global sanctions or fraud blacklist

rules.name: Escalate Transfers Over $1,000 for Human Sign-off
rules.description: Transfers between $1,000.01 and $10,000 require human operator confirmation.

conditions.description: Transfer amount between $1,000 and $10,000 requires human-in-the-loop signoff

rules.name: Permit Autonomous Micro-Transfers
rules.description: Permits transfers of $1,000 or below within authorized currency boundaries.

conditions.description: Transfer amount is within autonomous threshold ($1,000.00)
Transfer amount must be strictly positive

rules.name: Permit Read-Only Account Inquiries
rules.description: Allows read-only balance lookups and statement inquiries for verified agent contexts.
